title: Registry Index Entry
description: A single plugin entry in the Axolotl registry index (data/index.json). All plugin.yml-derived fields are re-fetched and overwritten by the sync workflow on every run — never trusted from a submission body.

id.description: GitHub owner/repo slug, used as the stable unique identifier for this plugin.

name.description: Plugin name, sourced directly from plugin.yml name field on every sync.

version.description: Latest version string from the most recent GitHub Release tag.

api.description: Array of supported PocketMine API version strings from plugin.yml api field.

author.description: Array of author strings from plugin.yml author/authors field.

description.description: Plugin description from plugin.yml description field.

category.description: Axolotl-defined category assigned at submission time and approved by a maintainer.

icon_path.description: Relative path to the icon file inside the plugin's repo, as submitted. Null means no explicit path was submitted — the sync workflow will attempt the `assets/icon.png` convention path as the first fallback before using the Axolotl default icon.

icon_url.description: Resolved raw.githubusercontent.com URL for the icon. Resolution order (Phase 4 sync workflow): (1) submitted icon_path → (2) convention path `assets/icon.png` → (3) Axolotl's own default icon (constant TBD, set in Phase 5). Each step is attempted only if the previous returned 404. The URL uses the literal `HEAD` segment in place of a branch name (e.g. `/owner/repo/HEAD/assets/icon.png`); GitHub resolves this server-side to the current default branch, so no prior API call to look up the default branch is needed.

repo_url.description: Direct GitHub URL to the plugin repository.

download_url.description: URL pointing to the .phar asset on the GitHub Releases page. Always originates from the plugin's own repo, never proxied through Axolotl.

download_count.description: Total GitHub Release asset download count, fetched on every sync. Null if the asset or release data is unavailable.

build_tier.description: Badge tier: 'verified' = has SLSA attestation; 'built-via-ci' = asset uploaded by github-actions[bot]; 'unverified' = manually uploaded asset; null = unknown/unavailable.

attestation_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the attestation check last ran. Null if the check has never run or the release is unavailable.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when a maintainer added the approved label — the moment this entry was first written to the index.

last_synced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when any field in this entry was last refreshed by the scheduled sync workflow.

unavailable.description: True if the plugin's repo went private, its release was removed, or the .phar asset is otherwise inaccessible. Plugin remains in the index as unavailable rather than being silently dropped.
